% References to labels of another document with xr and no hyperref, from
% an .aux that LaTeX wrote without hyperref (two fields per label) and
% from one written under hyperref (five fields). Each prints its number
% or page as in the PDF, and \getrefnumber its number. A label in an
% .aux that tex4ht wrote, with its .xref, still links to that document's
% page, and a label of this document to its heading.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xr}
\usepackage{refcount}
\newcounter{other}
\externaldocument[P-]{test-xr/plain}
\externaldocument[H-]{test-xr/latex}
\externaldocument[T-]{test-xr/tex4ht}
\begin{document}
Section \ref{P-s}, subsection \ref{P-ss}, page \pageref{P-front},
item \ref{P-item}, bold \ref{P-emph}, empty [\ref{P-none}].
Getrefnumber \setcounter{other}{\getrefnumber{P-s}}\arabic{other}.

Under hyperref: subsection \ref{H-ss}, page \pageref{H-front},
bold \ref{H-emph}, spaced \ref{H-step}, included \ref{H-c}.

Written by tex4ht: \ref{T-oss}.

\section{Here}\label{here}
Local \ref{here}.
\end{document}
